title: Spicy Prawn Arroz
description: A Spanish-style spicy prawn rice dish with chilli, garlic, peppers and lemon, simmered in vegetable stock with tomato purée.
ingredients: 300g (10.5oz) cooked and peeled cold-water prawns (if frozen, ensure thoroughly defrosted)
2 red chillies, deseeded and finely chopped
1 unwaxed lemon, zested, then cut into wedges
1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
1 green pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
small handful of parsley leaves, chopped to serve
steps: Spray a sauté pan, shallow flameproof casserole dish or large deep frying pan with oil, bring up to a high heat and add the prawns, chillies, garlic, lemon zest and pepper. Stir-fry for 2 minutes, then set aside in a bowl.
Spray a little more oil into the pan, add the onion and vinegar and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the peppers and fry for 3 minutes.

Stir the rice in, then pour in 600ml (20fl oz) of the hot stock, add the tomato purée, bring up to a fast simmer and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Return the prawn mixture, stirring it through the rice and allow to simmer for 5 minutes. Season with salt.
Try a little of the rice to check it is cooked through (if not, allow to simmer for longer, adding more stock if necessary).
Serve with chopped parsley and lemon wedges.
notes: To make this vegetarian, replace the prawns with extra vegetables such as mushrooms. Start the dish at step 2 with the chillies, garlic, lemon zest, pepper, then add the new vegetables with the peppers.
